messages:
rachel: Quick sync: OSS refapp + tutorial workshop on Thu. Tasks: launch post, short benchmark narrative (focus on cache effectiveness), 45-min workshop webinar, and inbound lead tagging. Who can take which piece?
tom: I9ll own slides + live demo steps. Hands-on lab: attendees deploy the refapp to minikube in ~20m.
priyanka: I9ll draft the launch post + community thread. Target 120-180 words, with 3 callouts and links to the repo + quickstart. Will include form and social copy.
dev-bot: CI build passed: refapp v0.3.0 -> s3://ci-artifacts/refapp/v0.3.0.tar.gz (sha256: abc123...)
hana: Bench lead here. Propose microbench set: 1) cache hit vs miss (p50/p95), 2) quantized vs fp16, 3) concurrency throughput @250 clients. Produce % improvements not raw overload of numbers.
rachel: Nice. Pri, include a tiny reproducible bench snippet in the post (<=4 lines).
priyanka: Draft snippet (will refine):
```
# cache vs no-cache (wrk)
wrk -t4 -c250 -d30s --latency http://demo.redwood.ai/oss/v0.3/generate
# quant bench (local script)
python tools/bench_quant.py --model models/oss_v0.3 --seq 512
```
priyanka: Form fields: name, email, org, role, use-case (checkboxes: prod/dev/research), "want hands-on lab" checkbox. SFDC campaign: MKG-OSS-2026-WK03. Tag leads: "oss-workshop-v0.3".
tom: Workshop scheduling: Thu 14:00 PT (Fri 09:00 CET). 45m including hands-on setup and live Q&A. Ops: can we get a persistent demo for 72h? @dev-bot confirm infra.
dev-bot: Created cluster: k8s-redwood-oss-demo (4xA10G, 2xjumpbox). URL: https://demo.redwood.ai/oss/v0.3. Expires in 72h. Read-only demo token issued.
hana: Draft hero metric for the post: "~85% lower p95 latency with KV cache + batching vs baseline". I'll validate and attach a 3-row table with p50/p95/cost-per-1k-tokens.
rachel: Also want 2 social cards: 1) workshop registration, 2) benchmark highlight. Short hero line for card: "Ship private refapps with predictable latency and lower cost."
priyanka: I9ll open a PR with the post, form, and social assets by EOD Wed. Will include contributing guide link and GitHub release notes.
tom: Need someone to moderate live chat during hands-on. Volunteers?
hana: I can moderate the first 30m and help with bench Qs.
rachel: Great. Owners: pri=post/form/social, hana=bench/hero-metric/moderator, tom=slides/demo, dev-bot=infra. Check-in tomorrow 09:30 PT. Any blockers?
priyanka: No blockers. Will ping design for card assets now.
hana: I9ll run final benchmark on Tue night and post numbers + small CSV to the shared folder.
dev-bot: Reminder: dry-run cluster will be available Wed 06:00 PT. Please use demo token, do not expose secrets.
rachel: Thanks team :party_parrot: See you 09:30 PT for the quick sync.
